children: UK tissue-healing tech firm's H1 revenue rose 4% year-on-year
Adjusted diluted EPS for H1 rose 10%, adjusted pretax profit up 11%
Reported pretax profit fell sharply due to exceptional restructuring and acquisition costs
Company expects further progress in H2 2026, citing strong competitive position and end-market dynamics
Acquisition by H.B. Fuller expected to complete in Q4 2026, pending satisfaction of remaining conditions
ORDER PHASING IMPACT - Lower Adhesives sales, especially LiquiBand in the US, due to prior year partner order phasing created a high comparator
CATEGORY MIX - Growth in Suture, Clips and VTO and Internal Fixation and Sealants, offsetting declines in Advanced Closure
RESTRUCTURING BENEFIT - Improved Woundcare performance and higher gross margins attributed to prior period restructuring initiatives
The current average analyst rating on the shares is "buy" and the breakdown of recommendations is 3 "strong buy" or "buy", 2 "hold" and no "sell" or "strong sell"
The average consensus recommendation for the medical equipment, supplies & distribution peer group is "buy"
Wall Street's median 12-month price target for Advanced Medical Solutions Group PLC is GBp285.00, about 1.4% above its September 15 closing price of GBp281.00
The stock recently traded at 18 times the next 12-month earnings vs. a P/E of 15 three months ago
